description:
Are you passionate about applying machine learning to transform the future of semiconductor design? At Falcomm, we are building GaNdalph.ai, an AI-native RF chip design platform that turns design cycles of months into minutes. We are seeking a full-time AI/ML Software Engineer to build and ship the transistor-level models at the core of the platform. You will turn device measurements and simulations into production models that predict how transistors behave across bias, frequency, power, and temperature. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and semiconductor devices, perfect for an engineer who wants their models used in real chips.
 We are seeking an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys hard technical problems, and is motivated to ship working product. This is a product role: your models go into the hands of chip designers and into tapeouts.
 
 
 Responsibilities
 Model Development: Build, train, and ship machine learning models that predict transistor behavior, including DC, small-signal, and large-signal performance.
 Data Pipelines: Automate ingestion and cleaning of device data from foundry PDKs, circuit simulation, and lab measurements such as I-V curves, S-parameters, and load-pull.
 Process Onboarding: Create a repeatable workflow for bringing a new foundry process into GaNdalph.ai, from raw data to a validated, released model.
 Validation: Build automated test suites that compare model predictions with simulation and measured silicon, and track accuracy for every release.
 Production Integration: Package and serve models for fast inference inside the GaNdalph.ai design flow.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with RF designers and the validation lab to turn device physics requirements into deployable software.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning or software engineering.
 Experience shipping machine learning models into production, not only training them.
 Proficiency in Python: object-oriented programming, automation, and testing.
 ML Framework Expertise: Experience building models with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
 Data Engineering: Strong grasp of data processing libraries (pandas, numpy, scipy) and large structured datasets. 
 Software Fundamentals: Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and version control (Git).
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an emphasis on RF/microwave integrated circuit design.
 Experience with foundation models, transformers, or sequence models trained on scientific or engineering data.
 Physics-informed machine learning or surrogate modeling experience.
 Understanding of semiconductor devices, especially GaN HEMTs or RF CMOS.
 Familiarity with compact device models and circuit simulators (SPICE, Spectre, Keysight ADS).
 Experience with distributed training on GPUs.
 Exposure to RF metrics such as gain, output power, and power-added efficiency.
 Benefits 
 Competitive Salary and Equity Package
 Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
 401(k) Retirement Plan
 Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
 
 DISCLOSURE
 Falcomm is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Falcomm is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
 Applicants wishing to view a copy of Falcomm’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify Falcomm.
 To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
